triage.test_level_policy: Augmented F2P entries are JUnit tests in a new streams/test-utils test file. They drive the public KIP-470 TestInputTopic, TestOutputTopic, TopologyTestDriver, and TestRecord APIs through a StreamsBuilder topology and public serializers/deserializers. The augmented P2P entry drives the unchanged public JsonConverter API in :connect:json, an independent module outside the KIP-470 streams changes.
triage.requirement_section_source: All requirement_sections strings are copied exactly from the Section column of requirement_pr_pairs/Apache-Kafka_KIP-470_TopologyTestDriver-test-input-and-output-usability-improvements_PR-7378.md.

org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.public_surface: TopologyTestDriver#createInputTopic, TestInputTopic#pipeInput, TestInputTopic#advanceTime, TestOutputTopic#readRecord, TestRecord constructors and equality.
org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.rationale: KIP-470 adds timestamp-managed input topics. This test verifies auto-advance order, manual advance, explicit TestRecord timestamps, and long timestamp overloads through the public input/output-topic round trip.

org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.public_surface: TopologyTestDriver#createInputTopic without start timestamp or autoAdvance, TestInputTopic#pipeInput, TestOutputTopic#readRecord.
org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.rationale: KIP-470 specifies that the simple input-topic factory uses the current time and disables auto-advance; this rejects default timestamp drift between consecutive records.

org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.public_surface: TopologyTestDriver#createInputTopic with Duration autoAdvance and TestInputTopic#advanceTime.
org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.rationale: The public timestamp-management API must reject negative durations both at topic creation and manual advancement.
KIP-470 adds bulk input and map output helpers; this verifies that key-value bulk input preserves keys and that map output still rejects null keys.
The new output topic API must accurately report queue state, deserialize keys and values independently, and throw on empty reads instead of returning null.

org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.public_surface: TestInputTopic#pipeValueList, TestInputTopic#pipeKeyValueList with timestamp advance, TestOutputTopic#readValuesToList, TestOutputTopic#readRecordsToList.
org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.rationale: Covers KIP-470 collection helpers through public bulk APIs, checking output ordering and timestamp progression across generated records.
Exercises factory-created topic objects on unknown-topic error paths and diagnostic public toString output without relying on internal test-driver classes.

org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.public_surface: TestInputTopic#pipeInput(value, Instant), TestInputTopic#pipeRecordList, TestInputTopic#pipeValueList(startTimestamp, advance), TestOutputTopic#readKeyValuesToList, TestOutputTopic#readValuesToList, deprecated TopologyTestDriver#pipeInput/#readOutput/#advanceWallClockTime bridge methods.
org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.rationale: Covers public collection and migration overloads that KIP-470 added or kept as deprecated bridges, including record-list piping, explicit timestamp value-list piping, list output reads, legacy raw driver input, wall-clock advancement, and deprecated null-on-missing output reads.

org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.public_surface: TestRecord constructors, accessors, toString, equals, hashCode, and ProducerRecord constructor bridge.
org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.rationale: KIP-470 introduces TestRecord as the public record value type; this pins timestamp access, constructor conversion, and timestamp-sensitive equality.

org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.public_surface: TestRecord public constructors, timestamp validation, getHeaders/getKey/getValue/getRecordTime accessors, ConsumerRecord constructor bridge, and equals branches.
org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsAugTe.rationale: Expands TestRecord coverage over null timestamp handling, invalid timestamp rejection, ConsumerRecord conversion, JavaBean-style accessors, and the public equality branch behavior around key, value, type, and timestamp differences.

org.apache.kafka.connect.json.JsonConver.public_surface: Unchanged org.apache.kafka.connect.json.JsonConverter public fromConnectData/toConnectData schemaless round trip behavior.
org.apache.kafka.connect.json.JsonConver.stability_goal: KIP-470 changes streams test utilities and must not affect the independent :connect:json conversion surface.
org.apache.kafka.connect.json.JsonConver.rationale: Pins an adjacent unchanged Kafka module through public JsonConverter behavior and does not call any PR-modified streams class.

org.apache.kafka.streams.TestTopicsTest#.system_reason: NEW test added by the PR (TestTopicsTest is a brand-new file in eval_tests.patch). Drives the new public TestInputTopic.pipeInput and TestOutputTopic.readValue API through a one-source/one-sink topology built via StreamsBuilder; observes value passthrough at the public output.

triage.fixture_taint_summary: TestTopicsTest and WordCountDemoTest are brand-new files added by eval_tests.patch — no fixture taint possible. The three DeveloperGuideTesting F2P methods all share the @Before block that constructs a tiny Processor topology + TopologyTestDriver; the @Before is also modified by eval_tests.patch (which is fine because the same modification is what enables these tests to run against the new API). The P2P JsonConverterTest entries live in :connect:json, a module entirely outside eval_tests.patch's reach — no taint possible.
triage.module_scope_rationale: F2P modules (:streams:test-utils, :streams:examples) host the new public KIP-470 API tests. P2P module (:connect:json) is independent: selected original tests exercise public JsonConverter behavior, never reference :streams or anything touched by the PR, and therefore are expected to compile and pass in both pre and post states.

f2p_intentionally_omitted.org.apache.kafka.streams.examples.wordco: Genuine F2P candidate (NEW file driving the public WordCountDemo via the new TestInputTopic/TestOutputTopic API), but its topology uses a KTable backed by the default RocksDB persistent store. rocksdbjni 5.18 (the version pinned by Kafka 2.4's gradle/dependencies.gradle) ships NO ARM64 native libs — UnsatisfiedLinkError at runtime on Apple Silicon hosts. Re-include once the bundle is rebuilt with --platform=linux/amd64 (Rosetta-translated) or rocksdbjni is bumped to a 6.x version with ARM64 support.
f2p_intentionally_omitted.org.apache.kafka.streams.examples.docs.D: All six rewritten methods build a topology with Stores.persistentKeyValueStore (RocksDB-backed); same UnsatisfiedLinkError on ARM64 as above.
f2p_intentionally_omitted.org.apache.kafka.streams.test.TestRecord: NEW test file for the public TestRecord value-type. Per Codex round-1 review, the file imports org.apache.kafka.common.header.internals.RecordHeader — `*.internals.*` matches §6.1's Java internal-symbol pattern. Excluded until a Kafka public_surface.yaml explicitly allow-lists common.header.internals as a test-allowed package.
f2p_intentionally_omitted.org.apache.kafka.streams.TopologyTestDri: Per Codex round-1 review, the modified TopologyTestDriverTest file imports org.apache.kafka.streams.state.internals.KeyValueStoreBuilder — an internal symbol. F2P candidates from this file are disqualified by §6.1 until either the import is removed by the agent or our public_surface.yaml is updated.

triage.test_compile_failure_pre_state: Expected for F2P (which lives in :streams:test-utils + :streams:examples). With only eval_tests.patch applied, tests in those modules reference TestInputTopic / TestOutputTopic / new TopologyTestDriver factories — all introduced by solution.patch and absent in the base sources. Module-scoped compile failure → ERROR for every F2P selector. P2P (:connect:json) is unaffected: it depends only on :clients and :connect:api (both at base, both unmodified), so its tests compile and PASS in pre-state.
